Succulent wild prawns simmer gently in an aromatic broth made from freshly extracted coconut milk, tangy tamarind paste, and tempered mustard seeds. A signature base of fried curry leaves, crushed shallots, and ginger-garlic paste imparts an earthy warmth that balances the natural sweetness of the fresh shellfish.
